bias.en: Downtrend · above the Nov 5 low, capped at $1,410
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 守在 11月5日低点上方，受制于 $1,410

read.en: ASML rose 0.9% on Nov 18 to $1,395.27, trading $1,368.01–1,411.50. It is below the 5-day ($1,435.5), 10-day ($1,451.4), 30-day ($1,575.8) and 100-day ($1,693.9), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($1,601.8). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($1,559.23), and RSI is 36.2.

No level changed: the $1,368.01 low held above the Nov 17 and Nov 5 lows, and the $1,411.50 high tested the $1,404–1,409 resistance, but the close stayed below it. Resistance is $1,404–1,411.5, then $1,424.8–1,447.5 (Nov 6 close, 5-day, Nov 16 high) and $1,451–1,462 (10-day, Nov 13 low). Support is $1,351.8–1,368, then $1,300. A close above $1,411.5 would target $1,425–1,447; below $1,351.8, $1,300.
